Item 2: Management’s Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations

Net revenue for the third quarter of 2025 increased 13% to $318.4 million compared with the same period of 2024, reflecting strong growth in our servo drive platform and improved pricing.

Gross margin was 38.9%, an improvement of 120 basis points, driven by favorable product mix and lower freight costs. Operating expenses increased 6% due to higher research and development investment.

Cash provided by operating activities was $96.3 million for the nine months ended September 30, 2025. We believe our liquidity remains sufficient for our needs over the next twelve months.

Item 1A
Risk Factors

Except as described below, there have been no material changes to the risk factors disclosed in Part I, Item 1A of our Annual Report on Form 10-K for the year ended December 31, 2024.

New tariffs announced in 2025 on imported electronic components could increase our cost of sales and reduce our gross margin. We may not be able to pass these increased costs on to our customers, and retaliatory tariffs could reduce demand for our products outside the U.S.
